Reviewer: wopr pool job unknown-4188, gpt-6.1-sol (Codex), mkinney; did not write or refresh this PR.

Needs changes before merge: one required evidence item is missing. All local checks passed.

### Requested before merge

1. `crates/tools/src/cutting.rs:177` and `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/stock_material.rs:40`: add before/after screenshots to the PR body. Copper adds a visible choice to the material pickers. The body has no screenshots. Show the picker before this change and with Copper selected after this change. Store the images on the author's fork, on its images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Link them from the body. Do not add screenshots to the PR branch.

### Scope and law checks

- I read the full diff and issue #3262. This is the first review; there are no earlier findings.
- I used `AGENTS.md` from upstream main `e6849c5aea183b81135c8143955cc8c88a429a89`.
- Copper is appended to the enum and both tables. Existing material words and indices stay valid.
- The tests cover milling and turning suggestions, the power estimate, tool limitations, MCP, save/reopen, and stock-material undo.
- The body has `Process change: yes`. The PR does not change `PROCESS_VERSION` or add dependencies.
- This is a safety-tier review: the material can supply posted feeds and spindle speeds.
- Goldens moved: none. No recorded programs or catalog files changed.

### Mutation checks

The body contains no author mutation record. I ran two independent mutations on copies under `/tmp/review-4188-mutations`. The PR worktree source stayed unchanged. The harness compiled the actual `cutting.rs` and `cutting_router.rs` modules with `rustc --test`.

The test was `cutting::tests::copper_preset_is_appended_non_router_and_keeps_existing_rows`.

### Limits and review state

No physical cutting test ran. Pixel snapshots and full heavy lanes did not run. The current upstream review law does not require full heavy lanes for this enhancement. No GitHub runner was used.

The environment has no `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` or `CLAUDE_JOB_DIR`; the pool job name is unavailable. The reviewer line uses `unknown-4188` for that missing value. The model name is from the local Codex configuration.

The PR is mergeable. Set `needs-rework` for the missing screenshots. Leave the contributor's ready state unchanged. Keep the worktree and branch for the next review.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: the missing UI before/after screenshots (review item 1 on head `1266caa46`).

@paulsvc, we made the screenshots for you. We did not change your branch or your PR body.

The images show the Stock page, Material group, "Workpiece material" picker. The picker list scrolls, so the second row shows the end of the list. Copper is appended at the end.

| | Before (merge base `12ea01a45`) | After (PR head `1266caa46`) |
|---|---|---|
| End of the picker list | ![before: list ends at HDPE](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/50ee5e4445146d435c31d23ef7128a3e74f829a9/4188/before-3-picker-end.png) | ![after: list ends at Copper (C11000)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/50ee5e4445146d435c31d23ef7128a3e74f829a9/4188/after-3-picker-end.png) |
| Picker state | ![before: picker open, top of list](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/50ee5e4445146d435c31d23ef7128a3e74f829a9/4188/before-1-picker-open.png) | ![after: Copper (C11000) selected](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/50ee5e4445146d435c31d23ef7128a3e74f829a9/4188/after-2-selected.png) |

- Before: merge base `12ea01a45eccfc5c4cd221834eeb7d3e0400f806` on upstream/main. The list ends at HDPE. There is no Copper.
- After: PR head `1266caa46ab71240070ac424eba8bf865f0ccaf4`. The list ends at "Copper (C11000)". With Copper selected, the picker and the status line show "Copper (C11000)".
- How we made them: an off-screen render with `egui_kittest` and the headless wgpu device, 1280 x 720, the seeded demo shell. No window opened. The scratch test used the same setup as `the_stock_page_states_the_stock_material_through_one_undo_step`. It opened the picker with a click, scrolled the list with the mouse wheel, and selected Copper with `SetStockMaterial`. The scratch test is not committed.
- Storage: the images are on the images-only branch `pr-screenshots` of `mkinney/Camcraft`, commit `50ee5e4445146d435c31d23ef7128a3e74f829a9`. The links use that commit, so they do not change.

Paste this table into the PR body under Screenshots (or tell us and we will), then comment here. A collaborator review of the same head then clears it.
